title: Clan War 1000 v 1000
summary: Two sanghas of a thousand agents meet in a game world. Each side has one Strategist, a few Captains and many squads of fighters. Inside each sangha, orders go down and scouting reports come up, and neighbouring squads assist each other. A Herald carries terms between the two Strategists, so even rivals keep their agreements and their honour. Cooperation is scored within each side and across both.
whenToUse: Large game worlds (clan wars, strategy games, raids), stress tests of orchestration, or any contest where many agents must act fast in formation.
strengths: Scales to thousands with cheap fighters
Fast local action under one strategy
Honour across sides keeps the game fair and fun
risks: Orders go stale in fast action
Needs firm limits so agents act only inside the game

smileMetrics.cooperation: Within a side: formations held and assists given. Across sides: terms kept.
smileMetrics.harmony: Squads acting on the current order.
smileMetrics.gathering: Time from a scout's report to the Strategist's new order.

communication: Each tick, orders pass Strategist to Captains to squad leads to fighters, and reports come back up the same chain. Neighbouring squads call each other for assists. The Herald carries terms between the Strategists.
cooperation: Within: formation held plus assists, per tick. Across: terms kept ÷ terms agreed. Cooperation = within × across.

Captain
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per wing. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🛡️📯 ***[$Wing$] Captain***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You command wing [$Wing$]. Turn the Strategist's plan into squad orders and send scouting news up. ) :)
(: Listen ( The Strategist and your squad leads. ) :)
[= Hold the formation. Report threats within one tick. Keep every agreed term. =]
[: Response Format (
🛡️📯 ***[$Wing$] Captain***:
# Orders
{squad and task}
# Report
{threats and openings}
) :]

(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You lead 25 fighters: [$Squad$]. ) :)

[= Act inside the game only. Assist the neighbouring squad when it calls. =]

{what the squad does this tick}
# Assist
{who you helped}
) :]
